evidence: Modifies the C and C++ kernel interfaces in src/kernel/error.h, notifications_interface.h, and bitcoinkernel.cpp, replacing bilingual_str with typed error structs and error codes.
rationale: Decoupling node translation dependencies from libbitcoinkernel advances tracking issue #27587's goal of isolating the kernel boundary. While it addresses the recurring architectural question of how the kernel reports fatal and flush errors, it is an internal boundary refactor that is reasonably deferrable.
